title: Mix unequal water masses
hints: The temperature is closer to that of the larger mass.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $20.0(T_f-70.0)+60.0(T_f-30.0)=0$ after canceling common specific heat, so $T_f=40.0^\circ$C.
statement:
Mix 20.0 g of water at 70.0 °C and 60.0 g at 30.0 °C in an insulated cup. What is the final temperature?

[_]{a}

explanations: The larger mass would have to be the hotter sample.
The hotter sample supplies nonzero heat.
